column1: # Slice F (clustered Bar) of GRAPH_PLAN.md. Default 1-2-3 R3.4a
# behavior for Bar with multiple populated A..F series and
# features.stacked = false: bars from each series sit side-by-side
# at every X position (a "group" per X).
# Each series uses a distinct shading glyph so identity reads
# visually: A → █, B → ▓, C → ▒, D → ░ (E/F cycle).
# Default Bar (stacked = false). Both A and B series should now
# render as side-by-side clusters per X position.
